references.text: God's promise to Caleb that he would receive the land he had spied out because he followed the Lord wholeheartedly.
Moses' restatement of the promise to Caleb that he would receive the land on which he had set his foot.
Caleb encouraged the people at Kadesh-Barnea to take possession of the land, demonstrating his faith in God.
The Lord declared that only Caleb and Joshua would see the Promised Land because they followed Him wholeheartedly.
Caleb recounts his faithful report from the spying mission, in contrast to the other spies.
The forty years Israel wandered in the wilderness as punishment, one year for each day the spies were in the land.
Confirmation of the 38 years from Kadesh-Barnea until they crossed the Zered Brook, part of the 45 years Caleb mentions.
